Vue.js is bundled with this plugin so the WebUI keeps working without a CDN.

File     : vue.global.prod.js
Version  : 3.4.38
Source   : https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vue@3.4.38/dist/vue.global.prod.js
SHA-256  : b50eeefe35d41636bb96c92b40f1df0b4fb7914e07b3c625b1ec15e9748767b9

The file is the unmodified official production build. Verify it with:
    python -c "import hashlib,sys;print(hashlib.sha256(open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read()).hexdigest())" vue.global.prod.js
